fields.label: Location
fields.note: ASP.NET auto-complete combo (ctl00$MainContent$RefineYourSearch$MultiCheckCombo1); options are loaded client-side.

fields.label: Industry
fields.note: ddlFunction option values 0201-0227; the category links use opaque func/desc/flag tokens.

notes: careers.jio.com is an ASP.NET WebForms site. The 'Refine your search' panel (Keyword, Select Industry, Location combo, Freshness) is inside <form method="post" action="./frmJobCategories.aspx"> and only posts back, so there is no GET filter parameter. Each industry link opens frmfuncwisejob.aspx?func=<token>&desc=<token>&flag=<token> (opaque base64, per-category, not a reusable filter value), and that page's pager also posts back. Filters are therefore applied locally by the scraper.
